senses.gloss: f. (v. preced.; cmp. חַלּוֹן) a back-gate. חוּלְדַּת המולים the mule-drivers’ gate, entrance for loads.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:18">Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:12:5">Y. Meg. IV, end, 75ᶜ</cite>.—
Midd. I, 3 שני שערי ח׳ two Temple-Mount gates formed like a ḥuldah; Cant. R. to II, 9 שער ח׳.
